objective_pt: Pedir e dar conselhos com "should", "If I were you, I'd...", "Why don't you...?" e "You'd better", e reagir a um conselho.

teacher.goal_pt: Aquecer pedindo e dando conselhos simples com "should".
prompts: I can't sleep at night. What should I do?
What's the best advice you've ever received?
watchFor: Dizer "You should to sleep"; depois de "should" não vem "to".
Usar "an advice"; "advice" é incontável: "some advice" ou "a piece of advice".

exercises.prompt: Can I ask you for some advice?
accepted: Can I ask you for some advice
Can I ask you for advice
Could I ask you for some advice

exercises.instruction_pt: Ouça e aconselhe a pessoa a ir ao médico.
exercises.listen: I've had a headache for three days.
accepted: You should see a doctor
You should go to the doctor
You should go see a doctor
Maybe you should see a doctor
I think you should see a doctor
Why don't you see a doctor
Why don't you go to the doctor
You'd better see a doctor
You should go to a doctor

commonErrors.explanation_pt: Depois de "should" vem o verbo direto, sem "to": "You should see a doctor".
commonErrors.correction_en: You should see a doctor.

commonErrors.explanation_pt: Ir ao médico é "go to the doctor" ou "see a doctor".
commonErrors.correction_en: You should go to the doctor.

options: Can you give me an advice?
Can you give me some advice?
exercises.explanation_pt: "Advice" é incontável em inglês: "some advice" ou "a piece of advice". Nunca "an advice" ou "advices".

teacher.goal_pt: Aprender expressões para dar conselhos de forma mais ou menos forte.
prompts: Give me advice about learning English.
watchFor: Usar "You'd better to go"; é "You'd better go".
Confundir "advice" (substantivo, "ss" no fim) com "advise" (verbo, "z" no fim).

exercises.example_en: If I were you, I'd talk to your boss.

exercises.meaning_pt: É melhor você (conselho forte, quase aviso)
exercises.example_en: You'd better leave now, or you'll miss the bus.
The course is expensive, but it's worth it.
You've been working too hard. Take it easy this weekend.

pairs.en: It might be a good idea to...

exercises.instruction_pt: Diga em inglês: "Se eu fosse você, eu aceitaria a oferta."
accepted: If I were you, I'd accept the offer
If I were you, I would accept the offer
If I was you, I'd accept the offer
If I was you, I would accept the offer
If I were you, I'd take the offer
If I were you, I would take the offer
I'd accept the offer if I were you
I would take the offer if I were you

commonErrors.explanation_pt: Situação imaginária usa o passado: "If I were you" (ou "If I was you", informal).
commonErrors.correction_en: If I were you, I'd accept the offer.

commonErrors.explanation_pt: Depois de "If I were you" use "would" ("I'd"), e não "will".
commonErrors.correction_en: If I were you, I'd accept the offer.

teacher.goal_pt: Pronunciar as formas reduzidas "I'd", "you'd" e o "l" mudo de "should".
prompts: Say "should", "could" and "would". Do you hear the L?
watchFor: Pronunciar o "l" de "should/could/would"; ele é mudo: "shud", "kud", "wud".
Omitir o "d" de "I'd" e "you'd", que muda o sentido da frase.

exercises.instruction_pt: Repita. O "l" de "should" e "would" é mudo.
exercises.prompt: You should rest, and I would drink more water.
accepted: You should rest, and I would drink more water
You should rest, and I'd drink more water
You'd better hurry up
You had better hurry up
You'd better hurry

exercises.instruction_pt: Em "should", qual letra não é pronunciada?

teacher.goal_pt: Entender um problema e responder com um conselho adequado.
prompts: My neighbor plays loud music every night. What should I do?
I want to save money. Any advice?
watchFor: Responder só "Yes" ou "Good idea" sem dar um conselho.
Usar "must" para conselho leve; "must" soa como obrigação.

exercises.instruction_pt: Ouça e escolha o conselho que a pessoa deu.
exercises.listen: If I were you, I wouldn't quit your job until you find a new one.
options: Não pedir demissão antes de achar outro emprego.
exercises.explanation_pt: "I wouldn't quit your job until you find a new one" = eu não pediria demissão até achar outro.

exercises.instruction_pt: Ouça e sugira, com "Why don't you...", que a pessoa converse com o vizinho.
exercises.listen: My neighbor plays loud music every night, and I can't sleep.
accepted: Why don't you talk to your neighbor
Why don't you talk to him
Why don't you talk to them
Why don't you speak to your neighbor
Why don't you talk with your neighbor
Why don't you have a chat with your neighbor
Why don't you go and talk to your neighbor

commonErrors.explanation_pt: Na pergunta, o auxiliar vem antes do sujeito: "Why don't you...?".
commonErrors.correction_en: Why don't you talk to your neighbor?

commonErrors.explanation_pt: Depois de "Why don't you" vem o verbo direto, sem "to".
commonErrors.correction_en: Why don't you talk to your neighbor?

exercises.instruction_pt: Ouça e dê um conselho para economizar dinheiro (por exemplo, cozinhar em casa).
exercises.listen: I spend too much money every month. What should I do?
accepted: You should *
Maybe you should *
I think you should *
Why don't you *
You should cook at home more
You should cook at home more often
I think you should cook at home more

commonErrors.explanation_pt: "Em casa" é "at home", sem artigo. "In the house" é dentro da construção.
commonErrors.correction_en: You should cook at home more.

commonErrors.explanation_pt: Depois de "should" vem o verbo direto, sem "to".
commonErrors.correction_en: You should cook at home more.

teacher.goal_pt: Trocar conselhos: ouvir um problema, sugerir duas opções e reagir ao conselho recebido.
prompts: My friend always borrows money and never pays it back. What should I do?
What advice would you give to someone moving to Brazil?
watchFor: Usar sempre "you should"; incentive variar com "Why don't you" e "If I were you".
Reagir só com "OK"; ensine "That's a good idea", "I'll try that".

exercises.instruction_pt: Diga em inglês: "Você não deveria trabalhar tanto."
accepted: You shouldn't work so much
You should not work so much
You shouldn't work so hard
You should not work so hard
You shouldn't be working so much
You shouldn't work that much

commonErrors.explanation_pt: "Should" já é auxiliar e faz a negação sozinho: "You shouldn't".
commonErrors.correction_en: You shouldn't work so much.

commonErrors.explanation_pt: "Tanto" com verbo é "so much" ou "so hard". "So many" é para coisas contáveis no plural.
commonErrors.correction_en: You shouldn't work so much.

exercises.instruction_pt: Diga em inglês: "Vale a pena tentar."
accepted: It's worth trying
It is worth trying
It's worth a try
It is worth a try
It's worth it to try
It's worth giving it a try

commonErrors.explanation_pt: "Vale a pena" não é "worth the pain". Em inglês é só "worth it" ou "worth + -ing".
commonErrors.correction_en: It's worth trying.

commonErrors.explanation_pt: Depois de "worth" o verbo vai com "-ing": "worth trying".
commonErrors.correction_en: It's worth trying.

exercises.instruction_pt: Coloque as palavras na ordem certa.
accepted: Have you thought about changing jobs?

exercises.instruction_pt: Dê conselhos a um amigo com um problema.
exercises.prompt_en: My friend wants to learn English fast, but he only has thirty minutes a day. What advice would you give him?
guidelines_pt: Use pelo menos três formas diferentes: "He should...", "Why doesn't he...?", "If I were him, I'd...".
Dê um motivo para cada conselho: "because...".
Diga o que ele não deveria fazer: "He shouldn't...".

teacher.goal_pt: Fixar "should" sem "to", "advice" incontável e "If I were you".
prompts: What should I do this weekend?
Give me one piece of advice about your city.

exercises.prompt: That's a good idea. I'll give it a try.
accepted: That's a good idea. I'll give it a try
That is a good idea. I will give it a try

exercises.instruction_pt: Diga em inglês: "Ela me deu um ótimo conselho."
accepted: She gave me some great advice
She gave me great advice
She gave me a great piece of advice
She gave me some really good advice
She gave me really good advice
She gave me very good advice

commonErrors.explanation_pt: "Advice" é incontável: "some great advice" ou "a great piece of advice", nunca "a great advice".
commonErrors.correction_en: She gave me some great advice.

exercises.instruction_pt: Qual conselho é o mais forte (quase um aviso)?
exercises.explanation_pt: "You'd better" é um conselho forte, com tom de aviso: senão, algo ruim pode acontecer.

exercises.instruction_pt: Complete com a forma certa de "be".
exercises.sentence: If I ___ you, I'd call her today.
accepted: were
was

commonErrors.explanation_pt: Situação imaginária usa o passado: "If I were you".
commonErrors.correction_en: If I were you, I'd call her today.

practice.example_en: Why don't you talk to your boss about it?

practice.meaning_pt: pensar melhor antes de decidir ("dormir sobre o assunto")
practice.example_en: Don't decide now. Sleep on it.

practice.instruction_pt: Repita. Em "I'd", o "d" é bem curto.
practice.prompt: If I were you, I'd talk to her first.
accepted: If I were you, I'd talk to her first
If I were you I would talk to her first

practice.instruction_pt: Repita a sugestão, ligando "why don't you".
practice.prompt: Why don't you take a few days off?
accepted: Why don't you take a few days off
Why don't you take some time off

practice.instruction_pt: Repita. "Shouldn't" soa "shudnt", sem o "l".
practice.prompt: You shouldn't stay up so late.
accepted: You shouldn't stay up so late
You should not stay up so late

practice.instruction_pt: Repita a frase.
practice.prompt: Have you thought about moving somewhere quieter?
accepted: Have you thought about moving somewhere quieter
Have you thought about moving to somewhere quieter

practice.instruction_pt: Repita o conselho mais forte, quase um aviso.
practice.prompt: You'd better see a doctor about that cough.
accepted: You'd better see a doctor about that cough
You had better see a doctor about that cough

practice.instruction_pt: Repita a frase.
practice.prompt: It might be worth asking for a second opinion.
accepted: It might be worth asking for a second opinion
It may be worth asking for a second opinion

practice.instruction_pt: Repita a resposta a um conselho.
practice.prompt: Thanks, that's really helpful. I'll think about it.
accepted: Thanks, that's really helpful. I'll think about it
Thank you, that's really helpful. I will think about it

practice.instruction_pt: Diga em inglês: "Você deveria dormir mais."
accepted: You should sleep more
You should get more sleep
You ought to sleep more
You should try to sleep more
You should get some more sleep

commonErrors.explanation_pt: Depois de "should" vem o verbo sem "to": "You should sleep".
commonErrors.correction_en: You should sleep more.

commonErrors.explanation_pt: "Must" é obrigação forte. Para conselho, "should" é o natural.
commonErrors.correction_en: You should sleep more.

practice.instruction_pt: Diga em inglês: "Se eu fosse você, eu não compraria esse carro."
accepted: If I were you, I wouldn't buy that car
If I were you, I would not buy that car
If I was you, I wouldn't buy that car
I wouldn't buy that car if I were you
If I were you, I wouldn't buy this car

commonErrors.explanation_pt: Para situações imaginárias, use "If I were you".
commonErrors.correction_en: If I were you, I wouldn't buy that car.

commonErrors.explanation_pt: Com "If I were you" use "would": "I wouldn't buy".
commonErrors.correction_en: If I were you, I wouldn't buy that car.

practice.instruction_pt: Diga em inglês: "Por que você não conversa com ele?"
accepted: Why don't you talk to him
Why don't you speak to him
Why don't you talk with him
Why don't you have a chat with him
Why don't you speak with him

commonErrors.explanation_pt: Na pergunta o auxiliar vem antes do sujeito: "Why don't you...?"
commonErrors.correction_en: Why don't you talk to him?

commonErrors.explanation_pt: "Conversar" no dia a dia é "talk to" ou "speak to". "Converse" é bem formal.
commonErrors.correction_en: Why don't you talk to him?

practice.instruction_pt: Diga em inglês: "Não vale a pena se preocupar com isso."
accepted: It's not worth worrying about
It isn't worth worrying about
It's not worth worrying about it
It's not worth worrying about that
There's no point worrying about it
It's not worth getting worried about

commonErrors.explanation_pt: Depois de "worth" o verbo vai com "-ing": "worth worrying".
commonErrors.correction_en: It's not worth worrying about.

commonErrors.explanation_pt: "Vale a pena" é "it's worth it"; não traduza "pena" ao pé da letra.
commonErrors.correction_en: It's not worth worrying about.

practice.instruction_pt: Diga em inglês: "Você já pensou em fazer um curso?"
accepted: Have you thought about taking a course
Have you ever thought about taking a course
Have you considered taking a course
Have you thought about doing a course
Have you ever thought about doing a course

commonErrors.explanation_pt: "Pensar em" é "think about", e não "think in".
commonErrors.correction_en: Have you thought about taking a course?

commonErrors.explanation_pt: Depois de preposição o verbo vai com "-ing": "about taking".
commonErrors.correction_en: Have you thought about taking a course?

practice.instruction_pt: Ouça e dê um conselho: ela deveria pedir um aumento.
practice.listen: I've been working really hard, but my salary hasn't changed in three years.
accepted: You should ask for a raise
I think you should ask for a raise
If I were you, I'd ask for a raise
Why don't you ask for a raise
You should ask for a pay rise
You should ask your boss for a raise

commonErrors.explanation_pt: "Aumento" de salário é "raise" (EUA) ou "pay rise" (Reino Unido).
commonErrors.correction_en: You should ask for a raise.

commonErrors.explanation_pt: "Pedir" algo é "ask for": "ask for a raise".
commonErrors.correction_en: You should ask for a raise.

practice.instruction_pt: Ouça e sugira que ele vá a pé ou de bicicleta.
practice.listen: I want to get fit, but I never have time to go to the gym.
accepted: Why don't you walk or cycle to work
You should walk or ride a bike to work
Why don't you walk or bike to work
You could cycle to work
You could walk to work instead
If I were you, I'd cycle to work

commonErrors.explanation_pt: "De bicicleta" é "by bike", ou use o verbo "cycle".
commonErrors.correction_en: Why don't you cycle to work?

commonErrors.explanation_pt: "A pé" é "on foot", ou só "walk".
commonErrors.correction_en: Why don't you walk to work?

practice.instruction_pt: Ouça e aconselhe a não tomar a decisão hoje.
practice.listen: They offered me a job in another city. Should I accept it right now?
accepted: I wouldn't decide today. Sleep on it
You should sleep on it
Don't decide today. Sleep on it
I'd sleep on it first
If I were you, I'd sleep on it
You'd better not decide today

commonErrors.explanation_pt: Para dar uma ordem negativa use "Don't": "Don't decide today".
commonErrors.correction_en: Don't decide today. Sleep on it.

commonErrors.explanation_pt: A expressão é "sleep on it".
commonErrors.correction_en: You should sleep on it.

practice.instruction_pt: Ouça e agradeça o conselho, dizendo que vai tentar.
practice.listen: Maybe you should try meditation before bed.
accepted: That's a good idea. I'll try it
Good idea, I'll give it a try
Thanks, I'll try that
That's a great idea. I'll try it tonight
Thanks, maybe I'll try it
That's a good idea, thanks

commonErrors.explanation_pt: Falta o sujeito: "That's a good idea".
commonErrors.correction_en: That's a good idea. I'll try it.

commonErrors.explanation_pt: Para decisão na hora, use "I'll": "I'll try it".
commonErrors.correction_en: That's a good idea. I'll try it.

practice.instruction_pt: Um amigo pede conselho. Dê sugestões a ele.
practice.scene_pt: Seu amigo está estressado com o trabalho e não sabe o que fazer.

turns.speaker: partner
turns.text: I'm so stressed. I've got too much work and I can't sleep.

turns.speaker: you
turns.cue_pt: Diga que sente muito e pergunte há quanto tempo ele se sente assim.
accepted: I'm sorry to hear that. How long have you felt like this
Oh no, I'm sorry. How long have you been feeling like this
I'm sorry. How long have you been feeling this way
I'm sorry to hear that. How long have you been like this
That's awful. How long have you felt this way

commonErrors.explanation_pt: Para algo que começou no passado e continua, use "How long have you felt...?"
commonErrors.correction_en: How long have you been feeling like this?

commonErrors.explanation_pt: A expressão é "I'm sorry to hear that".
commonErrors.correction_en: I'm sorry to hear that.

turns.speaker: partner
turns.text: About two months. Since my colleague left, I'm doing two jobs.

turns.speaker: you
turns.cue_pt: Aconselhe: se fosse você, conversaria com o chefe.
accepted: If I were you, I'd talk to your boss
If I were you, I would talk to my boss
If I were you, I'd speak to your boss
You should talk to your boss
Why don't you talk to your boss
If I were you, I'd talk to the boss

commonErrors.explanation_pt: Use "If I were you" para dar conselhos.
commonErrors.correction_en: If I were you, I'd talk to your boss.

commonErrors.explanation_pt: "Chefe" no trabalho é "boss" ou "manager".
commonErrors.correction_en: If I were you, I'd talk to your boss.

turns.speaker: partner
turns.text: I'm worried she'll think I can't handle it.

turns.speaker: you
turns.cue_pt: Diga que vale a pena tentar e que ela provavelmente vai entender.
accepted: It's worth a try. She'll probably understand
It's worth trying. She'll probably understand
It's worth it. She'll probably understand
I think it's worth a try. She'll probably understand
It's worth a try. I'm sure she'll understand

commonErrors.explanation_pt: "Vale a pena tentar" é "It's worth a try" ou "It's worth trying".
commonErrors.correction_en: It's worth a try. She'll probably understand.

commonErrors.explanation_pt: Com "she" e futuro: "she'll probably understand".
commonErrors.correction_en: It's worth a try. She'll probably understand.

turns.speaker: you
turns.cue_pt: Diga que ele deveria descansar no fim de semana e evitar o celular à noite.
accepted: You should take it easy this weekend and avoid your phone at night
You should rest this weekend and stay off your phone at night
Take it easy this weekend and avoid your phone at night
You should relax this weekend and avoid using your phone at night
You should take it easy at the weekend and avoid your phone at night

commonErrors.explanation_pt: Depois de "avoid" o verbo vai com "-ing": "avoid using".
commonErrors.correction_en: You should take it easy this weekend and avoid using your phone at night.

commonErrors.explanation_pt: "À noite" é "at night".
commonErrors.correction_en: You should take it easy this weekend and avoid your phone at night.

practice.instruction_pt: Dê conselhos para quem está começando a aprender inglês.
practice.prompt_en: A friend wants to start learning English. What advice would you give them?
guidelines_pt: Use "You should...", "Why don't you...?" e "If I were you, I'd...".
Explique por que cada um ajuda.

practice.instruction_pt: Qual frase está correta?
practice.explanation_pt: "Should" vem seguido do verbo sem "to" e sem "-ing".

practice.instruction_pt: Qual é a forma natural de pedir conselho?
options: What do you advise to me?
Can you give me an advice?
What would you do if you were me?
practice.explanation_pt: "Advice" é incontável (não diga "an advice"). "What would you do if you were me?" é natural.

practice.instruction_pt: Complete: "You'd better ___ (not / be) late tomorrow."
accepted: not be

commonErrors.explanation_pt: A negativa de "had better" é "had better not" + verbo: "You'd better not be late".
commonErrors.correction_en: You'd better not be late tomorrow.

practice.instruction_pt: Coloque as palavras na ordem certa.
accepted: What would you do if you were me?
